events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Tutorial Unit Fatigued

options.text: I'll March a Unit if I need it to move now!

events.text: This [unit] has used all of its moves and become Fatigue. A Fatigue Unit can still be moved with a March, but each move on a March costs twice as many Orders to execute. Your [unit] will refresh its moves next Turn.

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Tutorial: Undo

options.text: I'll Undo some Moves if I need to!

events.text: You can Undo as many decisions as you want, including moves, combat, building Improvement, and Event choices up to five past turns. Undo is performed with hotkey(HOTKEY_UNDO) or by pressing the backwards arrow icon(Undo_Normal) button in the bottom left of the screen.
